title: Refuse to ship when conjunct 2 fails and conjunct 3 passes (A3.9)

source.kind: invariant, green over the full k=6 space (86,849,955 distinct)

scenario: The anchor block is stamped past declared + delta, the sixth block inside. The issuer evaluates the three conjuncts on chain time plus depth (A7.6) and must not ship; the attempt is discarded and counts against N.
choices: The bridge has no refusal action; 'refuse' is read as 'Ship never fires in this state' (checked).

needs: An issuer test harness that feeds the service chosen header times (simulated chain or a header-source stub), then checks that no receipt is returned for that attempt and the attempt counter advances.

staging_harness.harness: staging issuer with (a) a header-source stub / simulated chain whose block times the tester sets, (b) a readable attempt log: attempt id, state transitions, per-request attempt counter, ship decision with the conjunct values
sequence: S1 submit request R at staged declared time d; record attempt id A1 and counter n0
S2 stub mines the anchor block h* with nTime d+DELTA+1
S3 stub mines h*+1..h*+5 one at a time, h*+5 with nTime d+DELTA-1 (six confirmations, the model's depth 5)
S4 hold the chain at h*+5 until the issuer records a decision for A1
observations: O1 the decision record for A1 carries c2 = false (and c1, c3 = true, depth = 6)
O2 A1 moves to discarded, with no shipped state before or after
O3 the attempt counter for R reads n0+1 (counted against N)
O4 no receipt for A1 is returned by the API or present in the issuer's outbox at any point
O5 the issuer starts attempt A2 (or, if A1 was the N-th, enters the refusal: see E10-ISS-04)

controls.change: S2 with nTime(h*) = d+DELTA and S3 with nTime(h*+5) = d+DELTA (all conjuncts pass at the boundary)
controls.expect: A1 ships; the receipt verifies VALID_STRICT, T = d+DELTA (cf. E10-TMP-06); counter not advanced by a discard

staging_harness.pass: O1-O4 hold for the refusal run and C1 ships; a refusal without the matching discard and counter observations is NOT a pass
staging_harness.test_oracle_limit: The TEST issuer (prototype/conformance/issue.py) only raises IssueRefused with receipt_c2 = false; it has no attempts, discard or N. The oracle fixes the pre-ship decision, not O2-O3.

status_note: requires staging harness; not exercisable through the public API alone
